name: Algar do Carvão
notes: Show cave run by Os Montanheiros, open to the public since the 1966 visitor tunnel; Monumento Natural Regional (Reserva Geológica 1987, MN since 2004); the crater drops ~45 m in a vertical conduit to a scree ramp, then a second drop to a clear lake, ~90 m total; extremely rare white amorphous-silica stalactites and stalagmites; two spider species are known only from here; first descent 1893; ~60,000 visitors in 2019; new CAVE visitor centre under construction since 10-2024. Entrance elevation: ~583 m commonly published, 629 m in the 1994 table, 603 m from GLO-30 at this point
volcanic_system: BFZ scoria cone over Pico Alto peralkaline trachyte

name: Gruta das Agulhas
notes: Coastal lava tube at Ponta dos Coelhos, base of Pico do Refugo; enter only at low tide with calm sea; cliff descent; initially called Galeria da Salga, and the 1994 paper uses G. da Salga. In 2023 the sea broke the lava platform at the only entrance and visits are now "muito problematica" in rough sea; the 2024-01-04 attempt to open the upstream entrance was abandoned (unstable slabs); the land is private
volcanic_system: Cinco Picos flank — Pico do Refugo eruption

name: Gruta dos Balcões
notes: Longest cave on Terceira (2713 m surveyed; 4421 m per GBIF; possibly 4.6+ km); Terreiro da Macela pastures; PR09TER trail passes nearby; also called Gruta do Bastião (1994); Pico Galiarte pahoehoe field; Nunes 2014 main entrance 38.76320 -27.25355, 186 m from this point
volcanic_system: BFZ central — Pico Galiarte pahoehoe field

name: Gruta da Branca Opala
notes: Opal/silica formations; three entrances (one skylight, two collapse); floods completely between survey points 8-11 on heavy-rain days; Pico Galiarte pahoehoe field (<6,600 y BP, Nunes 2014) - the older "Pau Velho 1761" attribution is superseded, the 1761 flow contains no caves; Nunes 2014 main entrance 38.77939 -27.25168, 125 m from this point; alt name G. do Rabão
volcanic_system: BFZ central — Pico Galiarte pahoehoe field

name: Gruta do Caldeira

volcanic_system: BFZ central — Pico Galiarte pahoehoe field

name: Gruta do Chocolate

name: Gruta da Madre de Deus

name: Gruta Brisa Azul
notes: Marine cave on the north face of Ilhéu Pequeno (western islet), Ilhéus das Cabras; boat only, ~10 min from Angra marina; opening about 4 m high at low tide. "Gruta dos Ratões" is another name for this same cave, not a separate one - four independent sources agree (CM Angra/Angrosfera "Gruta Briza Azul ou Gruta dos Ratões"; PdL 2018 pp. 49-52; Borges 1994 lists a single marine cave at the Ilhéus das Cabras, 80 m; dive.visitazores "north face of the western islet"). A coordinate sometimes given under the Ratões name, 38.63030 -27.14340, sits on the south side of the eastern islet - wrong islet and wrong face. Named 28-08-1971 after the launch "Briza Azul". Length 80 m official (SIGCAVA/IPEA/1994) but Barcelos re-measured ~50 m long x 10 m wide x 7-8 m high in 2018; the entry fissure runs surface to ~15 m and divers reach 24 m. SIGCAVA gives the freguesia as Feteira, PdL 2018 and pt.wikipedia say Porto Judeu (the islets were Feteira only 1911-1913); the SIGCAVA value is used here
aliases: Gruta Briza Azul; Gruta dos Ratões; Gruta do Ilhéu das Cabras
volcanic_system: Ilhéus das Cabras surtseyan tuff cone
